meta.title: Itihasa — Historical Epics of Sanātana Dharma
meta.description: Explore the great Indian epics — Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Bhagavad Gita — the historical narratives of Sanātana Dharma.

itihasa.title: Itihasa
itihasa.description: The Itihasas are the great historical epics of ancient India that teach dharma through narrative. They include the Ramayana, Mahabharata, and the Bhagavad Gita.
